summary: WaFd, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to announce a regular quarterly cash dividend on its 4.875% Series A Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The dividend is $12.1875 per preferred share ($0.30468750 per depositary share), payable July 15, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. No special situation event, acquisition, divestiture, or corporate action is involved; it is a routine dividend declaration. This filing does not meet the criteria for any special-situations category.
